description: This Java class implements an accounting processor that handles journal entries related to savings accounts in a cash-based accounting system. It creates journal entries based on various types of savings transactions such as deposits, withdrawals, interest posting, fees, penalties, transfers, overdrafts, and more, using helper methods to generate appropriate ledger entries.

classes.name: CashBasedAccountingProcessorForSavings
classes.description: A Spring component class responsible for creating cash-based journal entries for savings account transactions, implementing the AccountingProcessorForSavings interface.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForSavings
methods.description: Iterates over savings transactions, determines their type and context, and creates appropriate journal entries and reversals through helper methods, handling various transaction types such as deposits, withdrawals, interest, fees, penalties, transfers, overdraft, and more.
